blocks.html:
Lift Equipment Wrap

Momentum is a long-standing client of Vinyl Wrap Toronto. They brought this new Spider Bucket Lift recently. One of the first things they did was to bring it to us to add Logo decals. This equipment wrap was easy for our experienced installers and designers. With most full wraps, decals, or partials, it all starts with a mockup. This is where the graphic designer or artist takes pictures or outlines of the vehicle and starts placing the artwork. Most designs can do this quickly and are always open to suggestions and ideas from the client. Very few times have we had to say no to a customer. One of the main reasons is because we know the vinyl will fail due to wrapping textured plastic. Our customers trust us when we say we can wrap or not wrap the way they envision. Once the design is approved by the customer, we start to print, cut or print and cut. Momentum asked for all the decals to be Avery Dennison Sw900 Gloss White. So our team just cut the decals and then pre-masked them ready for our installation team. Our team had to remove the original decals on the Spider Lift. This was completed before our installation could begin. Once the old decals were removed and the lift was cleaned, we followed the proof to install the new Decals.
